title: SOC2 prep - risk & control mapping (scratchpad)
content:
Context:
- Personal scratchpad for SOC2 readiness (Type II). Working through control mappings for common criteria: CC1-CC7 and CC6 (System operations, change control, access) primarily.
- Goal: produce a clean control matrix for the compliance folder + list of evidence artifacts and owners.
- Not official doc; lots of TODOs and open questions.

High-level plan / milestones:
- Nov - Dec 2025: inventory existing controls/evidence (initial scan)
- Jan 2026: map controls to criteria and identify gaps
- Feb 2026: collect evidence, run tabletop w/ SRE/Product/Infra
- Mar 2026: finalize artifacts, hand off to auditor for pre-review

Immediate open items (prioritized):
1) Inventory for privileged access (CC6): we have IAM audit logs in Cloud, but need export process + retention proof. ACTION: Jordan to add log-export job and link S3 bucket (JIRA: JIRA-SOC-89).
2) Change control evidence (CC5): need signed PR review policy and release notes snapshot for last 6 months. ACTION: Priya to gather PR approvals + release snapshots.
3) Backup & restore testing (CC3): do we have documented restore tests for DB + model artifacts? Seems ad-hoc. ACTION: schedule restore run with infra (Maria).

Control mapping (working draft):
- CC1: Organization and management
  - Control: Security policy + responsibilities (owner: Security) -> Evidence: security-policy.md (confluence), org chart, training logs (training-2025.csv)
- CC2: Communication and information
  - Control: Incident response plan -> Evidence: incident-runbook-v2.md, last tabletop notes 2025-10-12
- CC3: Risk management
  - Control: Quarterly risk register review -> Evidence: risk-registry.xlsx (shared), meeting notes
- CC4: Monitoring and logging
  - Control: Centralized logging (ELK) + retention policy -> Evidence: logging-config.json, retention-policy.pdf, CloudWatch export job logs
- CC5: Change management
  - Control: PR review + approvals, release gating -> Evidence: github PR approvals (label: security-review), release notes archive
- CC6: Access controls
  - Control: Least privilege + periodic access reviews -> Evidence: IAM reports (last review 2025-09-01), access-review-checklist.xlsx
- CC7: System operations
  - Control: Backup schedule + restore tests -> Evidence: backup-schedule.csv, restore-test-run-2025-12-18.md

Evidence details / gaps (notes):
- IAM reports: need CSV export showing admin role counts over time. Current console screenshots are not sufficient.
- Training logs: some people trained in 2024 show missing completion dates; need certificate exports from LMS.
- Release notes: we have release notes in repo but not a signed/archived snapshot — need to export and sign off with release owner.
- Logging retention: policy exists but automated proof (S3 lifecycle) not documented.

Risk questions for review with Security lead (Priya):
- What counts as sufficient proof of periodic access review? (csv export vs screenshot vs ticket history)
- For backups: do we need yearly full-restore with validation, or is quarterly partial restore acceptable for model artifacts?
- For vendor management: how do we capture VPC endpoints / partner model providers in third-party inventory?

Evidence collection checklist (working):
- [ ] Export IAM roles + membership (CSV) -> owner: Jordan -> due 2026-03-05
- [ ] LMS training completion CSV -> owner: L&D (Priya) -> due 2026-02-20
- [ ] PR approval history (last 6 months) -> owner: Engineering -> done? needs validation
- [ ] Backup job configuration + restore-run logs -> owner: Infra (Maria) -> due 2026-03-10
- [ ] Logging export proof (S3 lifecycle + CloudWatch export) -> owner: Platform Ops -> due 2026-03-01
- [ ] Confluence policy export (PDF) -> owner: Security -> due 2026-02-25

Meeting notes / recent threads:
- 2026-02-15 sync with SRE + Infra: agreed to run restore test week of 2026-03-08. Action: Maria to schedule, include runbook.
- Slack: #soc2-prep thread has many links — consolidate important ones into confluence page and reference here.

Questions for auditor pre-check:
- Is our logging retention (90 days) sufficient for Type II? Auditor asked for 180 day examples historically — need to confirm.
- Do they accept manifests of evidence stored in internal S3 with access logs as proof, or do they require PDF snapshots?

Notes to self / TODOs:
- Convert this scratchpad into a control-matrix spreadsheet (columns: control id, description, criteria mapping, evidence links, owner, frequency, status).
- Add direct links to artifacts (S3 URIs, PR numbers) rather than Confluence pointers.
- Reconcile last 12 months of incidents with incident log for IR evidence.

Quick traceability sample (rough):
- Control: PR security review (CC5) -> Example evidence: github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/398 (labels: security-review / approved), jira ticket: ENG-512 (release gate)

Final thought: keep this lightweight and iteratively convert into shared spreadsheet. Most friction will be evidence export formats + agreeing owners on backups and access review cadence.

---
Revision history (manual):
- 2025-11-07: initial notes (Alex)
- 2026-01-12: added control mapping draft after sync w/ Priya
- 2026-02-15: updated restore test schedule after Infra meeting (Maria)
- 2026-02-28: cleaned up checklist and deadlines
